body.author: huahaiy
body.text: After 6 years of open source development, Datalevin has now reached 1.0. The goal of the project is to have better ergonomics than a SQL database for OLTP workloads. We have made Datalog practical by being competitive in relational and graph query performance, and by integrating full-text, vector search and document indexing into the same fact-based data model. I am the maintainer and happy to answer any questions.
body.title: Show HN: Datalevin – a simple, fast, and versatile Datalog database
